source.title: Ulster Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 5 ("Members of Clogher Council"); Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3 ("These are Tyrone's representatives: five contests for rural council seats")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There was no contest and no change in the composition of the council: eleven Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed, including five new members. The report does not give a party label for each division. Returned unopposed.
